item.title: Saturday 1 PM Update, Nov 14
item.description:
The Saturday 1 p.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 14, 2026: York, Maine weather through tomorrow; officials pin Friday's nationwide ground stop on a router swap during a copper-to-fiber upgrade; a real bomb found at a Peoria, Illinois ethanol plant; Mary Peltola widens her lead in Alaska's uncalled Senate race; Russia revives its 2021 NATO demands as Bulgaria halts arms to Ukraine; a fifth Saturday of protests across France; Cuba says it is preparing for a possible U.S. attack; new reporting on what Jensen Huang told Nvidia's lawyers and how he treated his successor; the Fed names A.I. the top risk to the financial system; the FBI warns about the ARTEX A.I. hacking tool; your X feed; murky well water at a Wells mobile home park plus Sunday picks; and a New Jersey police department's surprise for a teen recovering from surgery. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Saturday 10 AM Update, Nov 14
item.description:
The Saturday 10 a.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 14, 2026: York, Maine weather through tomorrow; day two of the flight mess and new reporting on what caused Friday's ground stop; Trump brings Elon Musk to Asia but won't press Xi on the Nvidia scandal; the Brooklyn collapse probe widens to more than 160 sites; Iran says three more tankers hit mines in Hormuz; a deadly night of Russian strikes on Zaporizhzhia; Canada's Carney sees progress toward a U.S. trade deal; Nvidia's CEO search, Tesla opens Cybercab orders, and Italy fines Meta; Dario Amodei on Anthropic's compute dilemma ahead of its IPO; thousands of hijacked GitHub accounts used to steal cloud keys; your X feed; Brewer, Maine opens the door to bigger data centers, plus tonight's Seacoast music; and a lonely vulture who found friends. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Saturday Morning, Nov 14
item.description:

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Friday 4 PM Update, Nov 13
item.description:

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
